landing.headline2: Your rank, your score, your call.
landing.lede: Broadcast platforms sell the same enquiry to everyone. We match each buyer to a few relevant sellers, show you how serious the buyer is, and refund you when a lead turns out fake.
landing.noGst: No GST needed to start. First listing in about five minutes.

cap.title: 3 sellers per lead, at most
cap.body: Every enquiry goes to a small, capped group instead of everyone in the category. No price wars with ten strangers.

intent.title: See intent before you spend
intent.body: Each lead shows a 0-100 intent score with the reasons, and your rank among the sellers who received it.

refund.title: Auto-refund, no ticket
refund.body: Buyer unreachable or fake? Report it within 72 hours and your credit is returned automatically.

badge.title: Badge is earned, never bought
badge.body: Verification comes from your GST and your track record. Paying more never changes your badge or your rank.

noSales.title: No field sales
noSales.body: Plans and prices are public and self-serve. Nobody will call to upsell you, and nothing renews on its own.

list.title: List by describing it
list.body: Tell us what you sell in Hindi, Hinglish or English, like a WhatsApp message. We draft the listing, you check it.

one.title: Tell us about your business
one.body: Name, city and a phone OTP. GST can wait.

two.title: Describe what you sell
two.body: Type it like you would tell a buyer. AI drafts the listing and you approve it.

three.title: Accept the leads you want
three.body: Pay one credit only when you accept. Decline the rest for free.

landing.pricingIntro: One credit per accepted lead. Unused credits roll over for 90 days. Plans never renew on their own and you can cancel in three taps.
landing.credits: {count, plural, one {# lead credit every month} other {# lead credits every month}}
landing.plansUnavailable: Plan details are not available right now. Sign up and see them in Billing.
landing.footerNote: Verification badges reflect your real verification tier, never your plan.
